items.title: Calabria Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 in Belgrade
items.description: (ANSA) - BELGRADO, 24 NOV - The Commissioner of the Italian Pavilion at Expo 2027 Belgrade, Ambassador to Serbia Luca Gori, and the President of the Calabria Region, Roberto Occhiuto, signed the agreement outlining the terms of the Region’s participation in the International Specialized Exposition, scheduled to take place in the Serbian capital from May 15 to August 15, 2027. Expo 2027 Belgrade, titled “Playing for Humanity: Sports and Music for All,” will feature the participation of approximately 140 countries. The signed agreement implements the Framework Agreement initialed on June 24, 202
items.titleIt: Calabria Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 in Belgrade

items.title: Lombardy Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 in Belgrade
items.description: (ANSA) - BELGRADO, 24 NOV - The Commissioner of the Italian Pavilion at Expo 2027 Belgrade, Ambassador to Serbia Luca Gori, and the President of the Lombardy Region, Attilio Fontana, signed the agreement outlining the terms of the Region’s participation in the International Specialized Exposition, scheduled to take place in the Serbian capital from May 15 to August 15, 2027. Expo 2027 Belgrade, titled “Playing for Humanity: Sports and Music for All,” will feature the participation of approximately 140 countries. The signed agreement implements the Framework Agreement initialed on June 24, 2026
items.titleIt: Lombardy Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 in Belgrade
